DeliveryPolicy.Rule: One coder chunk SHOULD target exactly one FC.
If an FC is too large, one chunk MAY target one to two BA regions inside the same FC.
Changed code volume SHOULD stay around 500 lines or less per chunk.
No more than 2-3 business-logic files SHOULD be changed in one coder chunk.
If a task cannot fit these bounds, coordinator must split it into a new CWO.
